primary_icp.title: Managing Partner / Practice Leader
pain_points: Poor ROI on digital marketing spend ($5K+/month with minimal case intake)
Slow lead response time causing caller abandonment (>30 sec response)
Inconsistent case quality and source tracking
Gap between marketing spend and actual billable cases
Inability to measure attribution across marketing channels
goals: Reduce cost per case acquisition by 40%+
Improve lead response speed to <15 seconds
Scale practice without proportional marketing spend increase
Align marketing metrics with actual case outcomes
objections: Skeptical of marketing agencies after prior poor experiences
Concern that legal marketing is commoditized/ineffective
Fear of losing control of client relationships
Budget constraints after failed ad spend
where_they_hang_out: LinkedIn (legal industry groups, practice management posts)
Legal practice management forums (LawFirm.com, Above the Law)
Local bar association meetings and CLEs
buying_triggers: Current Google Ads campaign underperforming for >3 months
Hired new business development person (seeking better tools/strategy)
Opened new practice area or office location

secondary_icp.title: Solo/Small Firm Attorney (Digital-Native)
secondary_icp.difference: 1-5 person firm, <$500K revenue, more hands-on with marketing, higher tech comfort, needs affordable/DIY-hybrid solutions, faster decision-making but tighter budgets

disqualifiers: Large AmLaw firms (200+ attorneys) - different buying process/budget structures
Practice areas with minimal digital marketing viability (e.g., government relations, M&A only)
Attorneys unwilling to change current marketing approach
Firms with <6 months runway before closure risk
